name: Spinner
summary: Spinning indicator for loading when you do not know how long it takes.
use: Content that loads inside an area or card.
In Button with State=Loading (already built in).
avoid: When the progress is known: use Progress.
Whole pages: think about skeleton views.
behaviour: Spins all the time. Respects prefers-reduced-motion.
a11y: role="status" with a text label, so screen readers announce the loading.
content: The label says what is loading: "Loading projects".
do: Show the spinner only after about 300 ms, so fast actions do not flicker.
dont: Several spinners on one screen at the same time.
